integrity: Exact generator identities and residual-graph checks are reproducible by included verification script; printed algebraic root approximation is numerical.
scientific_limitations: Finite, simple, homogeneous undirected SIS, independent unit recoveries, uniform one-person index case after one completely removed vertex, exact expected integrated prevalence. Not final SIR size, extinction-time minimization or empirical vaccination guidance. Novelty is a best-effort literature comparison; independent audit remains outstanding.
title: Five vertices are the sharp SIS vaccination-switch cutoff for cumulative infection burden
